build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon and letter index map
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models from a list of word pieces
compose_and_decompose_graphs: compose an input graph with a lexicon graph then project output to get word piece decompositions
compute_alignment_graph: compute the alignment graph by composing token graph with decomposition graph and projecting input
compute_sequence_loss: compute sequence level loss by subtracting forward scores of intersected emissions and alignment graphs
